title: EXERCISE: Terwillegar Park grass fire (Edmonton river valley)
summary: A mid-May afternoon grass fire in the North Saskatchewan river valley, before green-up. The wind rises faster than the players' forecast says.

caveats: The City LiDAR fuel grid has no accuracy assessment (docs/OVERVIEW.md §3).
Weather and FWI codes are scripted exercise values, not observations or a forecast.
Building footprints: Microsoft (2019 imagery) with uneven coverage; newer houses may be missing.

FireSim is a preparedness and training tool: held-out one-day skill is low (F1 0.246 on the pre-fire grid) and the ensemble is over-confident (49 % coverage). The fire in this pack is a scripted stimulus, not a prediction.

notesForFacilitator: EXERCISE. Truth: SW wind 20 km/h rising to 35 km/h at T+3 h (17:00 MDT); the players' forecast keeps 20-25 km/h, so the run outpaces the forecast. Reveal the divergence at the hot-wash. 15 May, before green-up (leaf-off: D-1 / M-1 by date); grass curing 80 %. Ignition is the E2E fixture point (terwillegar_grass_4h). Periods follow 08:00/20:00 boundaries: 14:00-20:00, 20:00-08:00, 08:00-14:00. The script holds its last step to the end of the exercise; add steps for a night-time drop if wanted. The perimeter inject at T+2 h uses the truth run's own perimeter at that time (delivered from PR3) and names no flight authorisation. Values set by the owner 2026-10-30 and revised the same day after a climatology check against CWFIS and ECCC station history (see the PR2 record).
